name: Eldritch Estate
source:
After receiving a mysterious letter regarding an inheritance from your late grandmother, you arrive at your newly owned mansion on a dark, stormy night, only to find that it comes with three unexpected residents -- your very own butler, maid, and new alleged "pet." Will you live happily ever after? Or is your new life just too good to be true?

[From [url=https://lostnightstudio.itch.io/eldritch-estate]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在收到一封关于已故祖母遗产的神秘信件后，你在一个漆黑的暴风雨之夜到达了你新拥有的豪宅，却发现里面来了三个意想不到的居民——你自己的管家、女仆和新的所谓“宠物”。从此以后你会幸福快乐地生活吗？或者你的新生活是否美好得令人难以置信？

[来自[url=https://lostnightstudio.itch.io/eldritch-estate]Itch.io[/url]]
